Beauty campaigns performed well across both major windows last year:

**Spring 2025 Beauty (RETRO-SP-2025-BTY)** — The "Find Your Glow" campaign ran March 3 through April 15 and came in 7% ahead of plan:
- Total revenue: $42.1M (plan was $39.3M)
- Email open rate: 32% (vs. 26% segment average)
- Paid social ROAS: 4.2x (vs. 3.5x target)
- In-store conversion: 18% uplift over comparable 2024 weeks

The standout was the Beauty Discovery segment (customers who browsed but hadn't purchased Beauty in 90 days), which converted at 2.1x the baseline. The sampling offer — a free 3-product sample box with $50 purchase — was the primary driver. Beauty Loyalists responded best to product depth (founder content, ritual videos) rather than discount messaging.

**Q4 2025 Holiday (RETRO-Q4-2025)** — Beauty Loyalists outperformed plan by 23%, with email open rates hitting 41% (vs. 28% target) and conversion at 1.6x the segment average. The early November teaser series was credited for front-loading gift set demand. Cross-channel consistency scored 4.6 out of 5 on the Brand audit, the highest in three years. The 5x Star Rewards weekend drove a 34% lift in repeat purchase rate.

One concern for your current campaign: Beauty Lapsed customers did not respond to the Spring reactivation series (10% off wasn't enough). Your 25% discount may perform better with this cohort, but it's worth watching closely.
